body:
Part-Of #505

Prepares the V3-F authority-transition decision surface before any C-SDLC v2-to-v3 tooling changeover. C-SDLC v2 remains the live lifecycle authority until #505 is reviewed, explicitly operator-approved, merged, and terminally reconciled; C-SDLC v3 remains construction and cutover evidence only before that point.

Changes:
- Adds `docs/csdlc-v3/TOOLING_CHANGEOVER_NOTICE.md` and sent the pre-changeover notification on #505 via typed C-SDLC v2 GitHub issue transport.
- Updates root `AGENTS.md`, `csdlc-v2/AGENTS.md`, `csdlc-v3/AGENTS.md`, onboarding, default workflow, architecture, and retained skill/editor docs so operators see the transition warning in advance.
- Updates active lifecycle docs/templates to the six-card `SIP -> STP -> SPP -> VPP -> SRP -> SOR` contract.
- Keeps `adl_pr_cycle`, `pr.sh`, and `pr ready/run/finish/closeout` language historical/retired rather than live route guidance.
- Strengthens the #505 validator to cover predecessor receipts, notification evidence, docs/skills/AGENTS surfaces, VPP lifecycle coverage, legacy-route rejection, and future closing linkage.
- Adds retained typed read/update request evidence for the current #505/#591 gate statement; this latest publication-head commit changes request evidence only.

Validation:
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/505/validate-authority-transition-prep.rb` — PASS after #504/#570/#571 terminal receipt gates became available.
- `./.adl/bin/csdlc-v2/csdlc-validate --root . issue --issue 505` — PASS, `phase: implemented`, generation 12.
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/570/validate-docs-routes.sh` — PASS in retained #505 evidence.
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/570/validate-skill-guidance.sh` — PASS in retained #505 evidence.
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/570/validate-authority-boundary.sh` — PASS in retained #505 evidence.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — PASS in retained #505 evidence.

Review:
- Prior full docs/changeover review `review_issue_505_final_docs_head` PASS at exact head `eb061985764cf8aad19b9d5df7fa7d5b7cfb3931`.
- Follow-up narrow SOR/status lifecycle-truth review `review_591_sor_truth` PASS at exact head `e70f2bb3563ff6284e0624bd536ede42175a54ee`, covering the post-review status/schema/request corrections.
- Current head adds retained typed readback/update request evidence only; it does not change the implementation, authority contract, docs, cards, or validator semantics.

Current gates:
- #601 must merge first so current main contains the terminalized #500/#501/#502/#503/#504/#570/#571 records and the #596 ready-state repair.
- #505 still requires explicit operator cutover approval before any PR body may use `Closes #505` or retire C-SDLC v2.

Notification:
- Typed issue notification sent before cutover; GitHub comment id `5472588060`.

Non-claims:
- This PR does not itself make v3 live authority, retire v2, merge/finish the issue, close #505, or bypass operator approval.
